items.root_cause: The daily runner audits the prompts (inside check-ad-cycles' test-auditors) BEFORE it runs the repair lane that reconciles them, so any project-scope prompt committed the day before is reported as hygiene drift and repaired minutes later by the same run: an alert whose own run fixes it.

root_fix.what: run the prompt-sync repair block before the downstream chain
root_fix.exact_change: Moved the whole 'THE AGENT PROMPTS GET A REPAIR LANE' block (unchanged condition: daily, not WhatIf, not NoDownstream; still non-fatal) to just above 'if ($runDownstream) {', with a note saying why; test-capture-run-sync gains a PROMPT SYNC ORDER group asserting the sync precedes the check-ad-cycles call.

prevention.what: the daily runner (the producer of both the audit run and its repair) repairs prompt drift before the chain that audits it
prevention.exact_change: the 'THE AGENT PROMPTS GET A REPAIR LANE' block moved above 'if ($runDownstream) {', held by test-capture-run-sync's PROMPT SYNC ORDER group

items.root_cause: Two detectors read the tree by rules that lagged the code they read: write-only-reports counted fixture writes as report families and knew write helpers but not read helpers, and the self-test census had no way for a whole-file suite that gained a hermetic -SelfTest to stay whole. The third red was a correct finding: a deliberate live read with no declaration.

root_fix.what: teach each detector the shape it lagged, never lower a bar
root_fix.exact_change: (1) write-only-reports: Get-FixtureLineSet (lib/selftest-lib.ps1 Get-SelfTestSpans) marks self-test body lines per .ps1, and a WRITE on such a line is not counted (reads still are, so it can only report fewer); Test-ReadVerb counts any Read-<Noun> command except Read-Host, the mirror of the 2026-09-11 write-helper rule. Live: 52 -> 32, no name outside the committed baseline; baseline recorded 34 -> 32 through the script's own -Tighten (Test-RatchetMove), bytes LF, CR 0. (2) selftest-lib: a test-*.ps1 carrying a comment line '# selftest-lib: whole-file-suite <why>' is read whole although it reads its switch; test-match-lib declares it. Census: 0 lost, test-match-lib 26 -> 30. (3) audit-search-terms: a LIVE-TWIN comment above its commodities.json read; fixture-inputs 0 new.

items.subject: Triage finding: plan status deviated is read as unfinished even when the root fix shipped
evidence: grocery/triage-return-lib.ps1:373 at cbbe61b42: 'if ($ps -ne ''deviated'' -and $ps -ne ''needs-more-time'') { continue }' - every deviated item is unfinished, whatever its leaves_open says
plan-2026-09-25-5.json item 2026-09-24-a9e8a0: status deviated, leaves_open 'nothing', leaves_open_occurrences 0, leaves_open_followup 'none'

Measured over the live queue (main checkout) and this worktree's 40 plans with Get-TriageUnfinished: HEAD lib 'unfinished=9 resume=1' (the 1 is a9e8a0); new lib 'unfinished=8 resume=0'. The three ids the finding named (a09096, c9f0f3, 0c8e6e) no longer surface under either lib today
items.root_cause: The plan status 'deviated' is written for two outcomes ('shipped differently' and 'root fix not landed') and the RESUME reader decided on the status alone, never on the residual fields the plan gate already requires beside it.

root_fix.what: Get-TriageUnfinished reads leaves_open and leaves_open_occurrences for a deviated item
root_fix.exact_change: A newest plan item with status deviated whose leaves_open matches ^nothing\b (case-insensitive) and whose leaves_open_occurrences is absent or 0 is finished and is not returned; needs-more-time is always returned; a deviated item with any other leaves_open (the d24000 watch-owned case) is returned exactly as before.

blast_radius.measured_by: not a matching rule: Get-TriageUnfinished over the live queue and 40 plan files, HEAD lib vs new lib, one row per unfinished id
blast_radius.risk: a developer who writes leaves_open 'nothing' over a real residual now hides it from RESUME; the -Closing gate already refuses a done/deviated item with a non-nothing leaves_open and no followup, so the word is already load-bearing

items.freshness: live queue read from the main checkout at 2026-09-25 ~19:50
